livingCosts.notes: LMU International Student Guide 'Living costs' (budget about EUR 1,500 a month in Munich): housing = midpoint of 'rooms in private housing including utilities 700-1,000' (university housing is 400-600); food = 'food, health insurance, leisure activities approx. 500' (the page does not split these, so the figure includes health insurance and leisure); transport = Deutschlandticket for students EUR 43/month; personal 0 because the page lists no separate personal/books figure (leisure is inside the food line). Semester fee (97) excluded.

programmes.name: Informatik B.Sc.
programmes.notes: LMU charges no tuition fees (none since winter 2013/14, also for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = Studierendenwerk München Oberbayern basic fee EUR 97.00 per semester x2 (from summer semester 2026; the semester-ticket surcharge has been suspended since winter 2023/24, so no transport ticket is included). Language of instruction: German. History: winter 2024/25 basic fee EUR 85.00 (LMU fee page); winter 2025/26 EUR 85.00 (Studierendenwerk basic-fee statute, 97 only from summer 2026).
